name: Do I need to get permits for exterior door replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to get permits for exterior door replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard exterior door replacements, especially those that do not involve structural changes to the wall, typically do not require a permit. However, if the project involves altering the size of the door opening or making significant structural modifications, a permit may be necessary. We can assist you in determining if your specific project in areas like Meridian or Star requires any local permits and can help plan accordingly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard door replacements usually don't require permits, but structural changes might.
